name: mount
summary: List the sources mounted into the machine, show their pending changes, or list them again
help: List the sources the host has mounted into the machine, one per line with its mode.
-r, --refresh   list each DIR's source again (every mount without DIR)
-c, --changes   show the changes waiting in each staged or live DIR (every mount without DIR)
The host application decides what happens to the changes: nothing (ro), applied when it reviews them

options.description: list the source of each DIR again
show the changes waiting in each DIR

messages.notFetched: not fetched from the mounted source yet (run the command again)
messages.conflict: {path}: changed in the source since it was read; the change stays pending
messages.timedOut: the source did not answer in time
messages.skipped: {dir}: skipped {count} entries with names that can't be files
messages.replay: {op} {path} is not in the Topwater recording

notes: Topwater's own command: real mount lists kernel filesystems. The listing uses the same 'SOURCE on DIR type TYPE (OPTIONS)' shape.
